message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time market data, so I can’t give you the exact gold price for today.  

If you need the most up‑to‑date price, you can check one of the following reliable sources:

| Source | How to access |
|--------|---------------|
| **Bloomberg** | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets/commodities |
| **Kitco** | https://www.kitco.com/ |
| **Reuters** | https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities |
| **London Bullion Market Association (LBMA)** | https://www.lbma.org.uk/ |
| **U.S. Treasury or Federal Reserve** | For official U.S. benchmarks, though they usually quote in USD per ounce |

These sites update gold prices (usually in U.S. dollars per troy ounce) several times per minute during market hours. If you’re looking for a historical trend or a specific time stamp, most of them also provide charts and archives.
